E018.description: Phase 1: Lock acquire fail (peer session running) — Retry x3 với 5s delay, ESCALATE.

E019.description: Phase 1: Heartbeat daemon spawn fail — Retry x1, ESCALATE.

E020.description: Phase 2: Phase 1 state missing (integrity-status.json) — Re-run Phase 1.

E026.description: Phase 2: API graph build fail (endpoint pattern không nhận) — Try alternative parsers.

E027.description: Phase 2: Event graph build fail (no broker config) — Skip event graph, WARN.

E028.description: Phase 2: RBAC matrix build fail — Try alternative auth patterns.

E029.description: Phase 2: Graph empty (≥1 graph có 0 nodes) — WARN, mark dim N/A.

E030.description: Phase 3: Phase 2 outputs incomplete (graphs missing) — Re-run Phase 2.

E032.description: Phase 3: Domain expert knowledge file missing (team-expert/{domain}/) — Fallback business-analyst, WARN.

E033.description: Phase 3: Profile-phase mismatch (vd profile=quick skip 3-pass LLM) — Auto-skip (info), không error.

E034.description: Phase 3: LLM API call timeout (>5 min/domain) — Retry x1, ESCALATE.

E035.description: Phase 3: LLM output schema invalid — Re-prompt với clarified output contract.

E036.description: Phase 3: Cross-domain conflict detected (>3 conflicts/session) — CDG E091 escalate batch.

E037.description: Phase 3: Invariant source_doc broken link — Re-link or DROP candidate.

E039.description: Phase 3: Sidecar artifact schema migration fail — ESCALATE manual migration.

E040.description: Phase 4: Lane dispatch fail — agent spawn error. Retry per-agent x1, ESCALATE batch.

E041.description: Phase 4: Probe timeout (>MCV3_CMI_LANE_TIMEOUT_SEC) — Mark lane TIMEOUT, continue others.

E042.description: Phase 4: System resource limit (cannot spawn 10 agents) — Reduce concurrency to 5, WARN.

E043.description: Phase 4: Lane activation mismatch (profile expected X lanes, got Y) — Re-validate profile config.

E044.description: Phase 4: Sidecar artifact schema mismatch — ESCALATE → Phase 3 re-run.

E045.description: Phase 4: Invariant incomplete (missing required fields) — Re-prompt agent.

E046.description: Phase 4: Orphan invariant (source_doc path not found) — Re-link or DROP.

E047.description: Phase 4: DATA INCONSISTENCY — claimed signal count ≠ actual files. ESCALATE possible agent corruption.

E049.description: Phase 4: Fingerprint collision — Dedupe, INFO log.

E052.description: Phase 5: Invalid dim value (not CD1-CD10) — DROP signal, WARN.

E054.description: Phase 5: Coverage compute fail (division by zero — no entities) — Mark dim N/A.

E062.description: Phase 6: GitNexus impact unavailable + git fallback only — Downgrade predictive → diff-aware, WARN.

E063.description: Phase 6: Scope mismatch (changed files ngoài scope) — Filter, WARN.

E064.description: Phase 6: Predictive confidence too low cho >50% predictions — Downgrade to diff-aware, WARN.

E097.description: CDG: Stale CDG decision (>7 days, registry changed since). AskUserQuestion: Re-confirm / Defer. Default DEFER.

E099.description: CDG: Destructive op (REJECT N existing invariants → mark stale). AskUserQuestion: Confirm / Cancel. Default ABORT.

E162.description: v3 Phase 9 Navigate fail (entry URL unreachable). Retry x3 với re-login, mark scenario FAIL nếu vẫn fail.
